--- file:///.src/mapConstToAs.ts ---
// @effect-v3
import * as Fx from "effect/Effect"
import { Effect, Option, pipe, Stream } from "effect"

const saveUser = (name: string): Effect.Effect<number> => Effect.succeed(name.length)
const numberEffect: Effect.Effect<number> = Effect.succeed(1)

declare const client: { readonly query: (sql: string) => Effect.Effect<void> }
const status = "saved"
const config = { retries: 3 }
let mutable = "mutable"

enum Phase {
  Done = "done",
  Failed = "failed"
}

// MUST TRIGGER: string literal body in a pipeable flow (issue example)
export const saved = saveUser("alice").pipe(Fx.as("saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: declared const identifier body (issue example)
export const ready = client.query("select 1").pipe(Effect.map(() => client))

// MUST TRIGGER: initialized const identifier declared before the call
export const constIdentifier = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))

// MUST TRIGGER: numeric, boolean, null and bigint literal bodies
export const numericLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 0))
export const booleanLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => true))
export const nullLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => null))
export const bigintLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 10n))

// MUST TRIGGER: negative numeric literal
export const negativeLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => -1))

// MUST TRIGGER: template literal without substitutions
export const plainTemplate = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `done`))

// MUST TRIGGER: enum member
export const enumMember = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Phase.Done))

// MUST TRIGGER: parenthesized constant body
export const parenthesized = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => ("saved")))

// MUST TRIGGER: sole parameter is declared but never referenced
export const ignoredParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_) => 0))

// MUST TRIGGER: block body with a single return of a constant
export const blockBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: function expression returning a constant
export const functionExpression = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function() {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: pipe function form
export const piped = pipe(numberEffect, Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first form
export const dataFirst = Effect.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST TRIGGER: data-last form applied directly
export const dataLast = Effect.map(() => "saved")(numberEffect)

// MUST TRIGGER: aliased module import
export const aliasedModule = numberEffect.pipe(Fx.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: the API reference is hidden behind a const alias
const mapAlias = Effect.map
export const aliasedMap = numberEffect.pipe(mapAlias(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: const identifier referenced from a nested scope
export function nestedScope() {
  return numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))
}

// MUST TRIGGER: constant map inside a longer pipe chain
export const chained = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.tap(() => Effect.void),
  Effect.map(() => "saved"),
  Effect.map((value) => value.length)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: already using Effect.as
export const alreadyAs = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.as("saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the callback reads its parameter
export const usesParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((n) => n * 2))
export const identity = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((n) => n))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the parameter shadows the outer const and is the returned value
export const shadowedParameter = client.query("select 1").pipe(
  Effect.map((client) => client)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: destructured parameter still reads the incoming value
export const destructured = Effect.succeed({ id: 1 }).pipe(Effect.map(({ id: _id }) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a default parameter initializer is evaluated on every run
export const defaultParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_ = 0) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: object and array literals build a fresh value per run;
// Effect.as would share a single instance across runs
export const objectLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.map(() => ({ kind: "abort" as const, code: null }))
)
export const arrayLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => [1, 2, 3]))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: template literal with substitutions is computed per run
export const templateWithSubstitution = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `status: ${status}`))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: calls and `new` may have side effects or build fresh values
export const callBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Option.none()))
export const newBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => new Date(0)))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: computed expressions are not constants
export const binaryBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 1 + 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: property access on a mutable object is read on every run
export const propertyAccess = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => config.retries))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: mutable binding; Effect.as would capture a stale value
export const mutableBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => mutable))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: const declared after the call; Effect.as would hit the TDZ
export const laterBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => later))
const later = "later"

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function parameters are mutable bindings
export const fromParameter = (value: string) => numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => value))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: void-producing bodies belong to effectMapVoid (Effect.asVoid)
export const voidUndefined = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => undefined))
export const voidZero = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => void 0))
export const voidEmptyBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: block body with more than a single return statement
export const multiStatementBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  mutable = "changed"
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free mapper, not an inline constant callback
const constantSaved = () => "saved"
export const pointFree = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(constantSaved))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Stream.map and Option.map are different APIs
export const streamMap = Stream.make(1).pipe(Stream.map(() => "saved"))
export const optionMap = Option.some(1).pipe(Option.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Array.prototype.map is not Effect.map
export const arrayMap = [1, 2, 3].map(() => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: unrelated map API with the same shape
const unrelated = { map: <A, B>(_input: A, f: () => B): B => f() }
export const unrelatedMap = unrelated.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a return type annotation pins the success type; Effect.as
// would infer it from the value instead (narrower: compile error downstream)
export const annotatedNarrowReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): "saved" => "saved"))
export const annotatedNarrowConsumer: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = annotatedNarrowReturn

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a wider return annotation would be silently narrowed by Effect.as
export const annotatedWideReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): string | number => 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function expression with a return type annotation
export const annotatedFunctionReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function(): "saved" {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: a contextual expected type infers the same success type for Effect.as
export const contextuallyTyped: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: an annotated but unused parameter does not affect the success type
export const annotatedParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_: number) => "saved"))

void mutable

export const templateWithSubstitution = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `status: ${status}`))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: calls and `new` may have side effects or build fresh values
export const callBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Option.none()))
export const newBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => new Date(0)))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: computed expressions are not constants
export const binaryBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 1 + 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: property access on a mutable object is read on every run
export const propertyAccess = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => config.retries))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: mutable binding; Effect.as would capture a stale value
export const mutableBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => mutable))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: const declared after the call; Effect.as would hit the TDZ
export const laterBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => later))
const later = "later"

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function parameters are mutable bindings
export const fromParameter = (value: string) => numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => value))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: void-producing bodies belong to effectMapVoid (Effect.asVoid)
export const voidUndefined = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => undefined))
export const voidZero = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => void 0))
export const voidEmptyBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: block body with more than a single return statement
export const multiStatementBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  mutable = "changed"
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free mapper, not an inline constant callback
const constantSaved = () => "saved"
export const pointFree = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(constantSaved))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Stream.map and Option.map are different APIs
export const streamMap = Stream.make(1).pipe(Stream.map(() => "saved"))
export const optionMap = Option.some(1).pipe(Option.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Array.prototype.map is not Effect.map
export const arrayMap = [1, 2, 3].map(() => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: unrelated map API with the same shape
const unrelated = { map: <A, B>(_input: A, f: () => B): B => f() }
export const unrelatedMap = unrelated.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a return type annotation pins the success type; Effect.as
// would infer it from the value instead (narrower: compile error downstream)
export const annotatedNarrowReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): "saved" => "saved"))
export const annotatedNarrowConsumer: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = annotatedNarrowReturn

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a wider return annotation would be silently narrowed by Effect.as
export const annotatedWideReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): string | number => 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function expression with a return type annotation
export const annotatedFunctionReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function(): "saved" {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: a contextual expected type infers the same success type for Effect.as
export const contextuallyTyped: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: an annotated but unused parameter does not affect the success type
export const annotatedParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_: number) => "saved"))

// @effect-v3
import * as Fx from "effect/Effect"
import { Effect, Option, pipe, Stream } from "effect"

const saveUser = (name: string): Effect.Effect<number> => Effect.succeed(name.length)
const numberEffect: Effect.Effect<number> = Effect.succeed(1)

declare const client: { readonly query: (sql: string) => Effect.Effect<void> }
const status = "saved"
const config = { retries: 3 }
let mutable = "mutable"

enum Phase {
  Done = "done",
  Failed = "failed"
}

// MUST TRIGGER: string literal body in a pipeable flow (issue example)
export const saved = saveUser("alice").pipe(Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: declared const identifier body (issue example)
export const ready = client.query("select 1").pipe(Effect.map(() => client))

// MUST TRIGGER: initialized const identifier declared before the call
export const constIdentifier = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))

// MUST TRIGGER: numeric, boolean, null and bigint literal bodies
export const numericLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Fx.as(0))
export const booleanLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => true))
export const nullLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => null))
export const bigintLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 10n))

// MUST TRIGGER: negative numeric literal
export const negativeLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => -1))

// MUST TRIGGER: template literal without substitutions
export const plainTemplate = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `done`))

// MUST TRIGGER: enum member
export const enumMember = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Phase.Done))

// MUST TRIGGER: parenthesized constant body
export const parenthesized = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => ("saved")))

// MUST TRIGGER: sole parameter is declared but never referenced
export const ignoredParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_) => 0))

// MUST TRIGGER: block body with a single return of a constant
export const blockBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: function expression returning a constant
export const functionExpression = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function() {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: pipe function form
export const piped = pipe(numberEffect, Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first form
export const dataFirst = Effect.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST TRIGGER: data-last form applied directly
export const dataLast = Effect.map(() => "saved")(numberEffect)

// MUST TRIGGER: aliased module import
export const aliasedModule = numberEffect.pipe(Fx.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: the API reference is hidden behind a const alias
const mapAlias = Effect.map
export const aliasedMap = numberEffect.pipe(mapAlias(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: const identifier referenced from a nested scope
export function nestedScope() {
  return numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))
}

// MUST TRIGGER: constant map inside a longer pipe chain
export const chained = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.tap(() => Effect.void),
  Effect.map(() => "saved"),
  Effect.map((value) => value.length)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: already using Effect.as
export const alreadyAs = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.as("saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the callback reads its parameter
export const usesParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((n) => n * 2))
export const identity = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((n) => n))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the parameter shadows the outer const and is the returned value
export const shadowedParameter = client.query("select 1").pipe(
  Effect.map((client) => client)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: destructured parameter still reads the incoming value
export const destructured = Effect.succeed({ id: 1 }).pipe(Effect.map(({ id: _id }) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a default parameter initializer is evaluated on every run
export const defaultParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_ = 0) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: object and array literals build a fresh value per run;
// Effect.as would share a single instance across runs
export const objectLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.map(() => ({ kind: "abort" as const, code: null }))
)
export const arrayLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => [1, 2, 3]))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: template literal with substitutions is computed per run
export const templateWithSubstitution = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `status: ${status}`))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: calls and `new` may have side effects or build fresh values
export const callBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Option.none()))
export const newBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => new Date(0)))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: computed expressions are not constants
export const binaryBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 1 + 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: property access on a mutable object is read on every run
export const propertyAccess = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => config.retries))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: mutable binding; Effect.as would capture a stale value
export const mutableBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => mutable))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: const declared after the call; Effect.as would hit the TDZ
export const laterBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => later))
const later = "later"

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function parameters are mutable bindings
export const fromParameter = (value: string) => numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => value))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: void-producing bodies belong to effectMapVoid (Effect.asVoid)
export const voidUndefined = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => undefined))
export const voidZero = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => void 0))
export const voidEmptyBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: block body with more than a single return statement
export const multiStatementBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  mutable = "changed"
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free mapper, not an inline constant callback
const constantSaved = () => "saved"
export const pointFree = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(constantSaved))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Stream.map and Option.map are different APIs
export const streamMap = Stream.make(1).pipe(Stream.map(() => "saved"))
export const optionMap = Option.some(1).pipe(Option.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Array.prototype.map is not Effect.map
export const arrayMap = [1, 2, 3].map(() => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: unrelated map API with the same shape
const unrelated = { map: <A, B>(_input: A, f: () => B): B => f() }
export const unrelatedMap = unrelated.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a return type annotation pins the success type; Effect.as
// would infer it from the value instead (narrower: compile error downstream)
export const annotatedNarrowReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): "saved" => "saved"))
export const annotatedNarrowConsumer: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = annotatedNarrowReturn

  return "saved"
}))

export const constIdentifier = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))

// MUST TRIGGER: numeric, boolean, null and bigint literal bodies

export const booleanLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => true))
export const nullLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => null))
export const bigintLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Fx.as(10n))

// MUST TRIGGER: negative numeric literal
export const negativeLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => -1))

// MUST TRIGGER: template literal without substitutions
export const plainTemplate = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `done`))

// MUST TRIGGER: enum member
export const enumMember = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Phase.Done))

// MUST TRIGGER: parenthesized constant body
export const parenthesized = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => ("saved")))

// MUST TRIGGER: sole parameter is declared but never referenced
export const ignoredParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_) => 0))

// MUST TRIGGER: block body with a single return of a constant
export const blockBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: function expression returning a constant
export const functionExpression = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function() {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: pipe function form
export const piped = pipe(numberEffect, Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first form
export const dataFirst = Effect.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST TRIGGER: data-last form applied directly
export const dataLast = Effect.map(() => "saved")(numberEffect)

// MUST TRIGGER: aliased module import
export const aliasedModule = numberEffect.pipe(Fx.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: the API reference is hidden behind a const alias
const mapAlias = Effect.map
export const aliasedMap = numberEffect.pipe(mapAlias(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: const identifier referenced from a nested scope
export function nestedScope() {
  return numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))
}

// MUST TRIGGER: constant map inside a longer pipe chain
export const chained = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.tap(() => Effect.void),
  Effect.map(() => "saved"),
  Effect.map((value) => value.length)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: already using Effect.as
export const alreadyAs = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.as("saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the callback reads its parameter
export const usesParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((n) => n * 2))
export const identity = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((n) => n))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the parameter shadows the outer const and is the returned value
export const shadowedParameter = client.query("select 1").pipe(
  Effect.map((client) => client)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: destructured parameter still reads the incoming value
export const destructured = Effect.succeed({ id: 1 }).pipe(Effect.map(({ id: _id }) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a default parameter initializer is evaluated on every run
export const defaultParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_ = 0) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: object and array literals build a fresh value per run;
// Effect.as would share a single instance across runs
export const objectLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.map(() => ({ kind: "abort" as const, code: null }))
)
export const arrayLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => [1, 2, 3]))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: template literal with substitutions is computed per run
export const templateWithSubstitution = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `status: ${status}`))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: calls and `new` may have side effects or build fresh values
export const callBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Option.none()))
export const newBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => new Date(0)))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: computed expressions are not constants
export const binaryBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 1 + 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: property access on a mutable object is read on every run
export const propertyAccess = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => config.retries))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: mutable binding; Effect.as would capture a stale value
export const mutableBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => mutable))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: const declared after the call; Effect.as would hit the TDZ
export const laterBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => later))
const later = "later"

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function parameters are mutable bindings
export const fromParameter = (value: string) => numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => value))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: void-producing bodies belong to effectMapVoid (Effect.asVoid)
export const voidUndefined = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => undefined))
export const voidZero = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => void 0))
export const voidEmptyBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: block body with more than a single return statement
export const multiStatementBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  mutable = "changed"
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free mapper, not an inline constant callback
const constantSaved = () => "saved"
export const pointFree = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(constantSaved))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Stream.map and Option.map are different APIs
export const streamMap = Stream.make(1).pipe(Stream.map(() => "saved"))
export const optionMap = Option.some(1).pipe(Option.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Array.prototype.map is not Effect.map
export const arrayMap = [1, 2, 3].map(() => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: unrelated map API with the same shape
const unrelated = { map: <A, B>(_input: A, f: () => B): B => f() }
export const unrelatedMap = unrelated.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a return type annotation pins the success type; Effect.as
// would infer it from the value instead (narrower: compile error downstream)
export const annotatedNarrowReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): "saved" => "saved"))
export const annotatedNarrowConsumer: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = annotatedNarrowReturn

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a wider return annotation would be silently narrowed by Effect.as
export const annotatedWideReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): string | number => 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function expression with a return type annotation
export const annotatedFunctionReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function(): "saved" {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: a contextual expected type infers the same success type for Effect.as
export const contextuallyTyped: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: an annotated but unused parameter does not affect the success type
export const annotatedParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_: number) => "saved"))

// @effect-v3
import * as Fx from "effect/Effect"
import { Effect, Option, pipe, Stream } from "effect"

const saveUser = (name: string): Effect.Effect<number> => Effect.succeed(name.length)

  Done = "done",
  Failed = "failed"
}

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: void-producing bodies belong to effectMapVoid (Effect.asVoid)
export const voidUndefined = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => undefined))
export const voidZero = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => void 0))
export const voidEmptyBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: block body with more than a single return statement
export const multiStatementBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  mutable = "changed"
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free mapper, not an inline constant callback
const constantSaved = () => "saved"
export const pointFree = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(constantSaved))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Stream.map and Option.map are different APIs
export const streamMap = Stream.make(1).pipe(Stream.map(() => "saved"))
export const optionMap = Option.some(1).pipe(Option.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Array.prototype.map is not Effect.map
export const arrayMap = [1, 2, 3].map(() => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: unrelated map API with the same shape
const unrelated = { map: <A, B>(_input: A, f: () => B): B => f() }
export const unrelatedMap = unrelated.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a return type annotation pins the success type; Effect.as
// would infer it from the value instead (narrower: compile error downstream)
export const annotatedNarrowReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): "saved" => "saved"))
export const annotatedNarrowConsumer: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = annotatedNarrowReturn

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a wider return annotation would be silently narrowed by Effect.as
export const annotatedWideReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): string | number => 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function expression with a return type annotation
export const annotatedFunctionReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function(): "saved" {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: a contextual expected type infers the same success type for Effect.as
export const contextuallyTyped: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: an annotated but unused parameter does not affect the success type
export const annotatedParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_: number) => "saved"))

// @effect-v3
import * as Fx from "effect/Effect"
import { Effect, Option, pipe, Stream } from "effect"

const saveUser = (name: string): Effect.Effect<number> => Effect.succeed(name.length)
const numberEffect: Effect.Effect<number> = Effect.succeed(1)

declare const client: { readonly query: (sql: string) => Effect.Effect<void> }
const status = "saved"
const config = { retries: 3 }
let mutable = "mutable"

enum Phase {
  Done = "done",
  Failed = "failed"
}

// MUST TRIGGER: string literal body in a pipeable flow (issue example)
export const saved = saveUser("alice").pipe(Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: declared const identifier body (issue example)
export const ready = client.query("select 1").pipe(Effect.map(() => client))

// MUST TRIGGER: initialized const identifier declared before the call
export const constIdentifier = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))

// MUST TRIGGER: numeric, boolean, null and bigint literal bodies
export const numericLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 0))
export const booleanLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => true))
export const nullLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => null))
export const bigintLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 10n))

// MUST TRIGGER: negative numeric literal
export const negativeLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => -1))

// MUST TRIGGER: template literal without substitutions
export const plainTemplate = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `done`))

// MUST TRIGGER: enum member
export const enumMember = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Phase.Done))

// MUST TRIGGER: parenthesized constant body
export const parenthesized = numberEffect.pipe(Fx.as("saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: sole parameter is declared but never referenced
export const ignoredParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_) => 0))

// MUST TRIGGER: block body with a single return of a constant
export const blockBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: function expression returning a constant
export const functionExpression = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function() {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: pipe function form
export const piped = pipe(numberEffect, Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first form
export const dataFirst = Effect.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST TRIGGER: data-last form applied directly
export const dataLast = Effect.map(() => "saved")(numberEffect)

// MUST TRIGGER: aliased module import
export const aliasedModule = numberEffect.pipe(Fx.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: the API reference is hidden behind a const alias
const mapAlias = Effect.map
export const aliasedMap = numberEffect.pipe(mapAlias(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: const identifier referenced from a nested scope
export function nestedScope() {
  return numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))
}

// MUST TRIGGER: constant map inside a longer pipe chain
export const chained = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.tap(() => Effect.void),
  Effect.map(() => "saved"),
  Effect.map((value) => value.length)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: already using Effect.as
export const alreadyAs = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.as("saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the callback reads its parameter
export const usesParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((n) => n * 2))
export const identity = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((n) => n))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the parameter shadows the outer const and is the returned value
export const shadowedParameter = client.query("select 1").pipe(
  Effect.map((client) => client)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: destructured parameter still reads the incoming value
export const destructured = Effect.succeed({ id: 1 }).pipe(Effect.map(({ id: _id }) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a default parameter initializer is evaluated on every run
export const defaultParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_ = 0) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: object and array literals build a fresh value per run;
// Effect.as would share a single instance across runs
export const objectLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.map(() => ({ kind: "abort" as const, code: null }))
)
export const arrayLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => [1, 2, 3]))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: template literal with substitutions is computed per run
export const templateWithSubstitution = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `status: ${status}`))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: calls and `new` may have side effects or build fresh values
export const callBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Option.none()))
export const newBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => new Date(0)))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: computed expressions are not constants
export const binaryBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 1 + 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: property access on a mutable object is read on every run
export const propertyAccess = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => config.retries))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: mutable binding; Effect.as would capture a stale value
export const mutableBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => mutable))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: const declared after the call; Effect.as would hit the TDZ
export const laterBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => later))
const later = "later"

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function parameters are mutable bindings
export const fromParameter = (value: string) => numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => value))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: void-producing bodies belong to effectMapVoid (Effect.asVoid)
export const voidUndefined = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => undefined))
export const voidZero = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => void 0))
export const voidEmptyBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: block body with more than a single return statement
export const multiStatementBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  mutable = "changed"
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free mapper, not an inline constant callback
const constantSaved = () => "saved"
export const pointFree = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(constantSaved))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Stream.map and Option.map are different APIs
export const streamMap = Stream.make(1).pipe(Stream.map(() => "saved"))
export const optionMap = Option.some(1).pipe(Option.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Array.prototype.map is not Effect.map
export const arrayMap = [1, 2, 3].map(() => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: unrelated map API with the same shape
const unrelated = { map: <A, B>(_input: A, f: () => B): B => f() }
export const unrelatedMap = unrelated.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a return type annotation pins the success type; Effect.as
// would infer it from the value instead (narrower: compile error downstream)
export const annotatedNarrowReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): "saved" => "saved"))
export const annotatedNarrowConsumer: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = annotatedNarrowReturn

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a wider return annotation would be silently narrowed by Effect.as
export const annotatedWideReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): string | number => 1))

  return "saved"

// @effect-v3
import * as Fx from "effect/Effect"
import { Effect, Option, pipe, Stream } from "effect"

const saveUser = (name: string): Effect.Effect<number> => Effect.succeed(name.length)
const numberEffect: Effect.Effect<number> = Effect.succeed(1)

declare const client: { readonly query: (sql: string) => Effect.Effect<void> }
const status = "saved"
const config = { retries: 3 }
let mutable = "mutable"

enum Phase {
  Done = "done",
  Failed = "failed"
}

// MUST TRIGGER: string literal body in a pipeable flow (issue example)
export const saved = saveUser("alice").pipe(Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: declared const identifier body (issue example)
export const ready = client.query("select 1").pipe(Effect.map(() => client))

// MUST TRIGGER: initialized const identifier declared before the call
export const constIdentifier = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))

// MUST TRIGGER: numeric, boolean, null and bigint literal bodies
export const numericLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 0))
export const booleanLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => true))
export const nullLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => null))
export const bigintLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 10n))

// MUST TRIGGER: negative numeric literal
export const negativeLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => -1))

// MUST TRIGGER: template literal without substitutions
export const plainTemplate = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `done`))

// MUST TRIGGER: enum member
export const enumMember = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Phase.Done))

// MUST TRIGGER: parenthesized constant body
export const parenthesized = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => ("saved")))

// MUST TRIGGER: sole parameter is declared but never referenced
export const ignoredParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_) => 0))

// MUST TRIGGER: block body with a single return of a constant
export const blockBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: function expression returning a constant
export const functionExpression = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function() {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first form

// MUST TRIGGER: data-last form applied directly

  return numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))
}

// MUST TRIGGER: constant map inside a longer pipe chain

  Effect.tap(() => Effect.void),
  Effect.map(() => "saved"),
  Effect.map((value) => value.length)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a default parameter initializer is evaluated on every run
export const defaultParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_ = 0) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: object and array literals build a fresh value per run;

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a return type annotation pins the success type; Effect.as
// would infer it from the value instead (narrower: compile error downstream)
export const annotatedNarrowReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): "saved" => "saved"))
export const annotatedNarrowConsumer: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = annotatedNarrowReturn

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a wider return annotation would be silently narrowed by Effect.as
export const annotatedWideReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): string | number => 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function expression with a return type annotation
export const annotatedFunctionReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function(): "saved" {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: a contextual expected type infers the same success type for Effect.as
export const contextuallyTyped: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: an annotated but unused parameter does not affect the success type
export const annotatedParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_: number) => "saved"))

// @effect-v3
import * as Fx from "effect/Effect"
import { Effect, Option, pipe, Stream } from "effect"

const saveUser = (name: string): Effect.Effect<number> => Effect.succeed(name.length)
const numberEffect: Effect.Effect<number> = Effect.succeed(1)

declare const client: { readonly query: (sql: string) => Effect.Effect<void> }
const status = "saved"
const config = { retries: 3 }
let mutable = "mutable"

enum Phase {
  Done = "done",
  Failed = "failed"
}

// MUST TRIGGER: string literal body in a pipeable flow (issue example)
export const saved = saveUser("alice").pipe(Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: declared const identifier body (issue example)
export const ready = client.query("select 1").pipe(Effect.map(() => client))

// MUST TRIGGER: initialized const identifier declared before the call
export const constIdentifier = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))

// MUST TRIGGER: numeric, boolean, null and bigint literal bodies
export const numericLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 0))
export const booleanLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => true))
export const nullLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => null))
export const bigintLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 10n))

// MUST TRIGGER: negative numeric literal
export const negativeLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => -1))

// MUST TRIGGER: template literal without substitutions
export const plainTemplate = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `done`))

// MUST TRIGGER: enum member
export const enumMember = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Phase.Done))

// MUST TRIGGER: parenthesized constant body
export const parenthesized = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => ("saved")))

// MUST TRIGGER: sole parameter is declared but never referenced
export const ignoredParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_) => 0))

// MUST TRIGGER: block body with a single return of a constant
export const blockBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: function expression returning a constant
export const functionExpression = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function() {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: pipe function form
export const piped = pipe(numberEffect, Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first form
export const dataFirst = Effect.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST TRIGGER: data-last form applied directly
export const dataLast = Effect.map(() => "saved")(numberEffect)

// MUST TRIGGER: aliased module import
export const aliasedModule = numberEffect.pipe(Fx.as("saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: the API reference is hidden behind a const alias
const mapAlias = Effect.map
export const aliasedMap = numberEffect.pipe(mapAlias(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: const identifier referenced from a nested scope
export function nestedScope() {
  return numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))
}

// MUST TRIGGER: constant map inside a longer pipe chain
export const chained = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.tap(() => Effect.void),
  Effect.map(() => "saved"),
  Effect.map((value) => value.length)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: already using Effect.as
export const alreadyAs = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.as("saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the callback reads its parameter
export const usesParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((n) => n * 2))
export const identity = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((n) => n))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the parameter shadows the outer const and is the returned value
export const shadowedParameter = client.query("select 1").pipe(
  Effect.map((client) => client)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: destructured parameter still reads the incoming value
export const destructured = Effect.succeed({ id: 1 }).pipe(Effect.map(({ id: _id }) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a default parameter initializer is evaluated on every run
export const defaultParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_ = 0) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: object and array literals build a fresh value per run;
// Effect.as would share a single instance across runs
export const objectLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.map(() => ({ kind: "abort" as const, code: null }))
)
export const arrayLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => [1, 2, 3]))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: template literal with substitutions is computed per run
export const templateWithSubstitution = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `status: ${status}`))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: calls and `new` may have side effects or build fresh values
export const callBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Option.none()))
export const newBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => new Date(0)))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: computed expressions are not constants
export const binaryBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 1 + 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: property access on a mutable object is read on every run
export const propertyAccess = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => config.retries))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: mutable binding; Effect.as would capture a stale value
export const mutableBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => mutable))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: const declared after the call; Effect.as would hit the TDZ
export const laterBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => later))
const later = "later"

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function parameters are mutable bindings
export const fromParameter = (value: string) => numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => value))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: void-producing bodies belong to effectMapVoid (Effect.asVoid)
export const voidUndefined = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => undefined))
export const voidZero = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => void 0))
export const voidEmptyBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: block body with more than a single return statement
export const multiStatementBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  mutable = "changed"
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free mapper, not an inline constant callback
const constantSaved = () => "saved"
export const pointFree = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(constantSaved))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Stream.map and Option.map are different APIs
export const streamMap = Stream.make(1).pipe(Stream.map(() => "saved"))
export const optionMap = Option.some(1).pipe(Option.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Array.prototype.map is not Effect.map
export const arrayMap = [1, 2, 3].map(() => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: unrelated map API with the same shape
const unrelated = { map: <A, B>(_input: A, f: () => B): B => f() }
export const unrelatedMap = unrelated.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a return type annotation pins the success type; Effect.as
// would infer it from the value instead (narrower: compile error downstream)
export const annotatedNarrowReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): "saved" => "saved"))
export const annotatedNarrowConsumer: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = annotatedNarrowReturn

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a wider return annotation would be silently narrowed by Effect.as
export const annotatedWideReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): string | number => 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function expression with a return type annotation
export const annotatedFunctionReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function(): "saved" {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: a contextual expected type infers the same success type for Effect.as
export const contextuallyTyped: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: an annotated but unused parameter does not affect the success type
export const annotatedParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_: number) => "saved"))

export const alreadyAs = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.as("saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the callback reads its parameter
export const usesParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((n) => n * 2))
export const identity = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((n) => n))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the parameter shadows the outer const and is the returned value
export const shadowedParameter = client.query("select 1").pipe(
  Effect.map((client) => client)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: destructured parameter still reads the incoming value
export const destructured = Effect.succeed({ id: 1 }).pipe(Effect.map(({ id: _id }) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a default parameter initializer is evaluated on every run
export const defaultParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_ = 0) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: object and array literals build a fresh value per run;
// Effect.as would share a single instance across runs
export const objectLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.map(() => ({ kind: "abort" as const, code: null }))
)
export const arrayLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => [1, 2, 3]))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: template literal with substitutions is computed per run
export const templateWithSubstitution = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `status: ${status}`))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: calls and `new` may have side effects or build fresh values
export const callBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Option.none()))
export const newBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => new Date(0)))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: computed expressions are not constants
export const binaryBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 1 + 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: property access on a mutable object is read on every run
export const propertyAccess = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => config.retries))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: mutable binding; Effect.as would capture a stale value
export const mutableBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => mutable))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: const declared after the call; Effect.as would hit the TDZ
export const laterBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => later))
const later = "later"

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function parameters are mutable bindings
export const fromParameter = (value: string) => numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => value))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: void-producing bodies belong to effectMapVoid (Effect.asVoid)
export const voidUndefined = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => undefined))
export const voidZero = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => void 0))
export const voidEmptyBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: block body with more than a single return statement
export const multiStatementBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  mutable = "changed"
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free mapper, not an inline constant callback
const constantSaved = () => "saved"
export const pointFree = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(constantSaved))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Stream.map and Option.map are different APIs
export const streamMap = Stream.make(1).pipe(Stream.map(() => "saved"))
export const optionMap = Option.some(1).pipe(Option.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Array.prototype.map is not Effect.map
export const arrayMap = [1, 2, 3].map(() => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: unrelated map API with the same shape
const unrelated = { map: <A, B>(_input: A, f: () => B): B => f() }
export const unrelatedMap = unrelated.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a return type annotation pins the success type; Effect.as
// would infer it from the value instead (narrower: compile error downstream)
export const annotatedNarrowReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): "saved" => "saved"))
export const annotatedNarrowConsumer: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = annotatedNarrowReturn

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a wider return annotation would be silently narrowed by Effect.as
export const annotatedWideReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): string | number => 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function expression with a return type annotation
export const annotatedFunctionReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function(): "saved" {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: a contextual expected type infers the same success type for Effect.as
export const contextuallyTyped: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: an annotated but unused parameter does not affect the success type
export const annotatedParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_: number) => "saved"))

// @effect-v3
import * as Fx from "effect/Effect"
import { Effect, Option, pipe, Stream } from "effect"

const saveUser = (name: string): Effect.Effect<number> => Effect.succeed(name.length)
const numberEffect: Effect.Effect<number> = Effect.succeed(1)

declare const client: { readonly query: (sql: string) => Effect.Effect<void> }
const status = "saved"
const config = { retries: 3 }
let mutable = "mutable"

enum Phase {
  Done = "done",
  Failed = "failed"
}

// MUST TRIGGER: string literal body in a pipeable flow (issue example)
export const saved = saveUser("alice").pipe(Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: declared const identifier body (issue example)
export const ready = client.query("select 1").pipe(Effect.map(() => client))

// MUST TRIGGER: initialized const identifier declared before the call
export const constIdentifier = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))

// MUST TRIGGER: numeric, boolean, null and bigint literal bodies
export const numericLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 0))
export const booleanLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => true))
export const nullLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => null))
export const bigintLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 10n))

// MUST TRIGGER: negative numeric literal
export const negativeLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => -1))

// MUST TRIGGER: template literal without substitutions
export const plainTemplate = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `done`))

// MUST TRIGGER: enum member
export const enumMember = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Phase.Done))

// MUST TRIGGER: parenthesized constant body
export const parenthesized = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => ("saved")))

// MUST TRIGGER: sole parameter is declared but never referenced
export const ignoredParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_) => 0))

// MUST TRIGGER: block body with a single return of a constant
export const blockBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: function expression returning a constant
export const functionExpression = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function() {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: pipe function form
export const piped = pipe(numberEffect, Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first form
export const dataFirst = Effect.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST TRIGGER: data-last form applied directly
export const dataLast = Effect.map(() => "saved")(numberEffect)

// MUST TRIGGER: aliased module import
export const aliasedModule = numberEffect.pipe(Fx.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: the API reference is hidden behind a const alias
const mapAlias = Effect.map
export const aliasedMap = numberEffect.pipe(mapAlias(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: const identifier referenced from a nested scope
export function nestedScope() {
  return numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))
}

// MUST TRIGGER: constant map inside a longer pipe chain
export const chained = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.tap(() => Effect.void),
  Effect.map(() => "saved"),
  Effect.map((value) => value.length)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: already using Effect.as
export const alreadyAs = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.as("saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the callback reads its parameter

  Effect.map((client) => client)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: destructured parameter still reads the incoming value
export const destructured = Effect.succeed({ id: 1 }).pipe(Effect.map(({ id: _id }) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a default parameter initializer is evaluated on every run
export const defaultParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_ = 0) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: object and array literals build a fresh value per run;
// Effect.as would share a single instance across runs
export const objectLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.map(() => ({ kind: "abort" as const, code: null }))

export const arrayLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => [1, 2, 3]))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: template literal with substitutions is computed per run
export const templateWithSubstitution = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `status: ${status}`))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: calls and `new` may have side effects or build fresh values
export const callBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Option.none()))
export const newBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => new Date(0)))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: computed expressions are not constants

=== [D25] Fix 1: "Disable mapConstToAs for entire file" ===

=== [D25] Fix 2: "Replace with Effect.as" ===

--- file:///.src/mapConstToAs.ts ---
// @effect-v3
import * as Fx from "effect/Effect"
import { Effect, Option, pipe, Stream } from "effect"

const saveUser = (name: string): Effect.Effect<number> => Effect.succeed(name.length)
const numberEffect: Effect.Effect<number> = Effect.succeed(1)

declare const client: { readonly query: (sql: string) => Effect.Effect<void> }
const status = "saved"
const config = { retries: 3 }
let mutable = "mutable"

enum Phase {
  Done = "done",
  Failed = "failed"
}

// MUST TRIGGER: string literal body in a pipeable flow (issue example)
export const saved = saveUser("alice").pipe(Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: declared const identifier body (issue example)
export const ready = client.query("select 1").pipe(Effect.map(() => client))

// MUST TRIGGER: initialized const identifier declared before the call
export const constIdentifier = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))

// MUST TRIGGER: numeric, boolean, null and bigint literal bodies
export const numericLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 0))
export const booleanLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => true))
export const nullLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => null))
export const bigintLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 10n))

// MUST TRIGGER: negative numeric literal
export const negativeLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => -1))

// MUST TRIGGER: template literal without substitutions
export const plainTemplate = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `done`))

// MUST TRIGGER: enum member
export const enumMember = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Phase.Done))

// MUST TRIGGER: parenthesized constant body
export const parenthesized = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => ("saved")))

// MUST TRIGGER: sole parameter is declared but never referenced
export const ignoredParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_) => 0))

// MUST TRIGGER: block body with a single return of a constant
export const blockBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: function expression returning a constant
export const functionExpression = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function() {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: pipe function form
export const piped = pipe(numberEffect, Effect.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: data-first form
export const dataFirst = Effect.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST TRIGGER: data-last form applied directly
export const dataLast = Effect.map(() => "saved")(numberEffect)

// MUST TRIGGER: aliased module import
export const aliasedModule = numberEffect.pipe(Fx.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: the API reference is hidden behind a const alias
const mapAlias = Effect.map
export const aliasedMap = numberEffect.pipe(mapAlias(() => "saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: const identifier referenced from a nested scope
export function nestedScope() {
  return numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => status))
}

// MUST TRIGGER: constant map inside a longer pipe chain
export const chained = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.tap(() => Effect.void),
  Effect.map(() => "saved"),
  Effect.map((value) => value.length)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: already using Effect.as
export const alreadyAs = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.as("saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the callback reads its parameter
export const usesParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((n) => n * 2))
export const identity = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((n) => n))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the parameter shadows the outer const and is the returned value
export const shadowedParameter = client.query("select 1").pipe(
  Effect.map((client) => client)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: destructured parameter still reads the incoming value
export const destructured = Effect.succeed({ id: 1 }).pipe(Effect.map(({ id: _id }) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a default parameter initializer is evaluated on every run
export const defaultParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_ = 0) => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: object and array literals build a fresh value per run;
// Effect.as would share a single instance across runs
export const objectLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.map(() => ({ kind: "abort" as const, code: null }))
)
export const arrayLiteral = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => [1, 2, 3]))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: template literal with substitutions is computed per run
export const templateWithSubstitution = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => `status: ${status}`))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: calls and `new` may have side effects or build fresh values
export const callBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => Option.none()))
export const newBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => new Date(0)))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: computed expressions are not constants
export const binaryBody = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => 1 + 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: property access on a mutable object is read on every run
export const propertyAccess = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => config.retries))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: mutable binding; Effect.as would capture a stale value
export const mutableBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => mutable))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: const declared after the call; Effect.as would hit the TDZ
export const laterBinding = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => later))
const later = "later"

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function parameters are mutable bindings
export const fromParameter = (value: string) => numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => value))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: void-producing bodies belong to effectMapVoid (Effect.asVoid)
export const voidUndefined = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => undefined))
export const voidZero = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => void 0))
export const voidEmptyBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: block body with more than a single return statement
export const multiStatementBlock = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(() => {
  mutable = "changed"
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free mapper, not an inline constant callback
const constantSaved = () => "saved"
export const pointFree = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(constantSaved))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Stream.map and Option.map are different APIs
export const streamMap = Stream.make(1).pipe(Stream.map(() => "saved"))
export const optionMap = Option.some(1).pipe(Option.map(() => "saved"))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Array.prototype.map is not Effect.map
export const arrayMap = [1, 2, 3].map(() => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: unrelated map API with the same shape
const unrelated = { map: <A, B>(_input: A, f: () => B): B => f() }
export const unrelatedMap = unrelated.map(numberEffect, () => "saved")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a return type annotation pins the success type; Effect.as
// would infer it from the value instead (narrower: compile error downstream)
export const annotatedNarrowReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): "saved" => "saved"))
export const annotatedNarrowConsumer: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = annotatedNarrowReturn

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a wider return annotation would be silently narrowed by Effect.as
export const annotatedWideReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((): string | number => 1))

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: function expression with a return type annotation
export const annotatedFunctionReturn = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map(function(): "saved" {
  return "saved"
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: a contextual expected type infers the same success type for Effect.as
export const contextuallyTyped: Effect.Effect<"saved"> = numberEffect.pipe(Fx.as("saved"))

// MUST TRIGGER: an annotated but unused parameter does not affect the success type
export const annotatedParameter = numberEffect.pipe(Effect.map((_: number) => "saved"))

void mutable

skipped by default
